name: nifty50-ml-trading-app
description: Merged NIFTY 50 ML Trading dashboard: React/Vite frontend + FastAPI ML backend, run together with `npm run dev`.

scripts.dev: concurrently -n BACKEND,FRONTEND -c blue,green "npm run dev:backend" "npm run dev:frontend"
scripts.dev:backend: cd backend && (if exist .venv\Scripts\python.exe (.venv\Scripts\python.exe -m uvicorn api.app:app --reload --host 0.0.0.0 --port 8000) else (python -m uvicorn api.app:app --reload --host 0.0.0.0 --port 8000))
scripts.install:backend: python -m pip install --upgrade pip && python -m pip install -r backend/requirements.txt
scripts.setup: npm run install:frontend && npm run install:backend
